fields.statement: A fresh index open first compares a fingerprint of the names in log/ and each change set folder's stat (modification time, mode, change time, inode and device) with the one stored at the last catch-up, and skips listing the folders when they match; any mismatch, or a folder modified within the last two seconds, falls back to deciding freshness by names.
fields.wording: agent of change set 01M5SWTJ, in autonomous mode

ops.note: refines it: the stat fingerprint is a pre-check that skips the listing when nothing changed; names still decide freshness on any mismatch

fields.result: TestReadBudget on an M3 Pro (11 CPUs), two runs per setting: default procs roadmap 4.93-5.29 ms and ready 4.92-5.11 ms (target 6 ms); GOMAXPROCS=2 roadmap 5.30-6.14 ms and ready 5.25-6.09 ms (target 10 ms); show 1.35-1.73 ms. make check exit 0.
fields.statement: roadmap and ready read the 50,000-node model well under the 50 ms budget: TestReadBudget medians of about 5 ms on an M3 Pro at default procs and 5.3-6.1 ms at GOMAXPROCS=2, from about 15 ms before the change set.
fields.tests: go test: TestReadBudget (internal/api), the freshness tests (internal/index), DecodeCanonical tests (internal/entry)
